name: Crash Fixes
description: Small fixes for Discord crashes: an unknown stream resolution or frame rate no longer throws, a race in Discord's database worker is reordered, a database that fails to open no longer breaks start-up, and the GIF picker's right-click menu gets the GIF's full details.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), thororen, nyx and Naibuu (Equicord), the patches of plugin EquicordHelper
